_comment: Claude Code global settings. Copy this to ~/.claude/settings.json (on WSL2/Linux/macOS that is your home folder's .claude directory). The hook paths below use $HOME so they resolve to your own home folder automatically — you do NOT need to edit them as long as you also copy the hooks/ folder to ~/.claude/hooks/.
_comment_autocompact: Auto-compaction lets long conversations keep going by summarizing older messages instead of running out of room. Leave on.
_comment_history: How many days of local conversation history to keep before cleanup. 365 = one year, a sensible default. Lower it if you want less kept on disk.
_comment_env: The env block holds real environment variables, so only put actual variables here (no comment keys). We deliberately do NOT set DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER, which keeps the auto-updater ON so you stay current. ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H turns on 1-hour prompt caching to reduce cost/latency on long sessions.
_comment_permissions: Permission prompts are intentionally LEFT ON. Claude Code will ask you before running commands or editing files it isn't already allowed to. As a newer user this is your most important safety layer — do not disable it until you are comfortable. (Power users sometimes turn these off; that is deliberately NOT done here.)
